description_en: Obtains Object Storage Service (OSS) authorization. After obtaining the authorization, you can use the OSS SDK to upload image or video files to a specified path and then call the LinkImage operation to add the image to a sub-scene
description_zh: 获取oss授权，获取授权后使用OSS SDK往指定路径上传图片或视频文件，上传完后直接调用LinkImage接口往子场景中添加图片
name: GetOssPolicy

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The authentication diagnostics details returned when permission verification fails. The details include the authentication principal, operation, policy, and cause of denial
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 权限校验失败时返回的鉴权诊断详情，包含鉴权主体、操作、策略和拒绝原因

AuthAction.description_en: The authentication operation that triggered the no-permission error. You can use this information to troubleshoot the issue or grant the required permissions
AuthAction.description_zh: 触发无权限错误的鉴权操作，可用于排查或授予所需权限

AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_en: The identity identifier of the authentication principal. The display format varies for RAM users, RAM roles, and SSO federated identities
AuthPrincipalDisplayName.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份标识；RAM 用户、RAM 角色和 SSO 联合身份的展示形式不同

AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the authentication principal belongs
AuthPrincipalOwnerId.description_zh: 鉴权主体所属阿里云账号的 UID

AuthPrincipalType.description_en: The identity type of the authentication principal, such as a RAM user, RAM role, or SSO federated identity
AuthPrincipalType.description_zh: 鉴权主体的身份类型，例如 RAM 用户、RAM 角色或 SSO 联合身份

EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_en: The encoded diagnostic information for the no-permission error. You can provide this information to an authorized account administrator to decode and troubleshoot the cause of denial
EncodedDiagnosticMessage.description_zh: 无权限错误的编码诊断信息，可交由具备权限的账号管理员解码以排查拒绝原因

NoPermissionType.description_en: The type of the no-permission cause. This distinguishes between not being explicitly authorized and being explicitly denied
NoPermissionType.description_zh: 无权限原因类型，区分未被显式授权和被显式拒绝

PolicyType.description_en: The type of the policy that caused the no-permission error, such as a control policy, session policy, or identity-based policy
PolicyType.description_zh: 导致无权限的策略类型，例如管控策略、会话策略或基于身份的策略

AccessId.description_en: The access ID. This parameter is used when you upload files by using the OSS SDK and corresponds to OSSAccessKeyId

Callback.description_en: The upload callback. This is a reserved field and is not used
Callback.description_zh: 上传回调，保留字段，目前未使用

Dir.description_en: The authorized path. This parameter is used when you upload files by using the OSS SDK. You must append the file name to the path before use. For example, ${DIR}/xxx.jpg corresponds to the key
Dir.description_zh: 授权路径，OSS SDK上传时参数，需要拼接文件名后使用， ${DIR}/xxx.jpg对应key

Expire.description_en: The expiration time of the authorization, in seconds. You can use this parameter to check whether the authorization is valid. The authorization becomes unavailable after it expires
Expire.description_zh: 授权失效时间(s)，可以判断授权是否在有效期内，失效后授权不可用

Host.description_en: The upload URL. This is the request URL used when you upload files by using the OSS SDK
Host.description_zh: 上传地址, OSS SDK上传时的请求地址

Policy.description_en: The authorization policy. This parameter is used when you upload files by using the OSS SDK and corresponds to the policy parameter
Policy.description_zh: 授权，OSS SDK上传时参数，对应policy

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which corresponds to the requestId request parameter

Signature.description_en: The signature. This parameter is used when you upload files by using the OSS SDK and corresponds to the signature parameter
Signature.description_zh: 签名，OSS SDK上传时参数，对应signature

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
